column1: # Charon fleet roadmap — canonical source of truth for status/handoff reports.
# One row per item. Tab-separated. Fields: project<TAB>id<TAB>status<TAB>phase<TAB>name<TAB>goal<TAB>wave
# status: done in-review building queued designed parked not-started
# phase:  4th field, retained for back-compat; the renderer DERIVES the phase word from status
# goal:   plain-language outcome, <= 6 words, no status words (the status symbol carries status).
# wave:   7th field, OPTIONAL. "Wave A" / "Wave B" / ... groups items inside a project. If ANY item
#         in a project has a wave, that project renders wave sub-headers (wave-less items -> Unscheduled);
#         projects with NO waves render FLAT.
# PROJECT numbers are assigned by project order-of-first-appearance; rows render in input order.
# ORDER CONVENTION (2026-07-10 agreed): within each project, order rows by STATUS PROGRESSION —
#   done -> building(now) -> queued -> designed -> parked -> not-started, ascending ID within a status.
#   (SECURITY is the reference.) KEEP this order when adding/updating rows; do NOT sort by ID.
# Edit this file to move an item; fleet/report.sh re-renders the canonical format from it.
